context:
Goal: the stale-draft row needs no hand-dumped live file.
Problem (goal): the build reads open PRs from REST itself, but Python cannot list sessions, so the lane, held and reviewLog checks still need a fresh live file. With a stale or missing file the row reads unknown, never clear. Needs the owner's word because option b adds a secret and a reach to a service.
Based on (measured): the live file was 19 h old and held 200 of about 500 PRs.
Departs from: main — the row needs the live file for the PR list; this lane — only for sessions.
Meanwhile: the lane keeps option a; its draft PR #3531 waits on nothing.

options.how: The row keeps reading sessions from the live file; the PR list already comes from REST.
options.label: Keep as is, sessions from the live file
options.lose: The row still reads unknown when the file is stale.

options.gain: The row is fully independent of the live file.
options.how: build.py reads sessions from a source the owner names, such as an API token.
options.label: Give build.py a sessions read from a named source
options.lose: A new secret and a reach to a service.

ref: lane stale-drafts-read-rest; draft PR #3531 (the stale-draft row)

shown.label: Keep as is, sessions from the live file
Give build.py a sessions read from a named source

title: Should the stale-draft row read sessions from a named source, so it needs no hand-dumped live file?
why: Option a adds no secret and no reach; the row already reads unknown, never clear, when the file is stale.
